title: Command event
description: One run of an isoplane command, recorded when the command ends.

id.description: A random identifier for this event, so that one sent twice is stored once.

occurredAt.description: When the command ended, in UTC, by this machine's clock.

installId.description: The random identifier of this installation, from telemetry/state.json in the Isoplane home directory. Absent on continuous integration machines.

ci.description: Whether the command ran on a continuous integration machine.

ciProvider.description: The continuous integration service the command ran on, or other for one the CLI does not recognise. Absent when it did not run on one.

agent.description: The coding agent that ran the command, when its environment identifies one.

command.description: The command that ran. A name the CLI does not recognise is recorded as unknown, never as typed.

mode.description: Why the command ran: test when Isoplane.Testing started it, debug for a debugging session, and run otherwise.

exitCode.description: The exit code the command returned. Absent when the command crashed.

failure.description: The category of the error that ended the command, when one did. Error messages are never recorded.

durationMs.description: How long the command ran, in milliseconds.

cliVersion.description: The version of the isoplane CLI.

platform.description: The operating system family and the processor architecture the CLI runs as, such as linux-x64 or win-arm64.

osArchitecture.description: The machine's processor architecture, such as x64 or arm64. It differs from the platform's when the CLI runs under emulation: an x64 .NET under Rosetta 2 on an Apple silicon Mac, or on Windows on Arm.

osVersion.description: The operating system's version number; on Linux, the kernel's.

distribution.description: The Linux distribution's identifier from os-release, such as ubuntu. Absent on other systems and when the file is missing.

distributionVersion.description: The Linux distribution's version from os-release, such as 24.04. Absent on other systems and on distributions without one.

runtimeVersion.description: The version of the .NET runtime the CLI ran on.

locale.description: The language and region the CLI would display messages in, such as en-NZ. Absent when the machine sets none.
